card.name: Digits in years and reading-text terms
card.fires_on: Mostly the middle digit of a four-digit year (e.g. 1950, 1985, 1898) in biographical or reference text, and the start of words like Phon(emic) in reading-instruction text. Also fires on 'single' before '-byte' in character-encoding text.

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: A digit partway through a year in a citation or biography about a reading researcher or reference book.
